title.en: d-orbital Splitting in an Octahedral Field
title.hi: अष्टफलकीय क्षेत्र में d-कक्षक का विपाटन

description.en: In an octahedral crystal field, the five degenerate d-orbitals split into two sets: a lower energy $t_{2g}$ set (dxY, dyz, dzx) and a higher energy $e_g$ set (dx2-y2, dz2). The energy difference is denoted by $\Delta_o$.
description.hi: एक अष्टफलकीय क्रिस्टल क्षेत्र में, पाँच समभ्रंश d-कक्षक दो सेटों में विपाटित हो जाते हैं: एक निम्न ऊर्जा $t_{2g}$ सेट (dxy, dyz, dzx) और एक उच्च ऊर्जा $e_g$ सेट (dx2-y2, dz2)। ऊर्जा अंतर को $\Delta_o$ द्वारा दर्शाया जाता है।
description.hinglish: Octahedral crystal field mein, paanch degenerate d-orbitals do sets mein split hote hain: ek lower energy $t_{2g}$ set (dxy, dyz, dzx) aur ek higher energy $e_g$ set (dx2-y2, dz2). Energy difference ko $\Delta_o$ se denote kiya jata hai.

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Y Axis (Energy) -->
  <line x1="50" y1="350" x2="50" y2="50" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="50,50 45,60 55,60" fill="#4b5563" />
  <text x="20" y="200" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151" transform="rotate(-90 20,200)" text-anchor="middle">Energy</text>

  <!-- Free Metal Ion (Degenerate) -->
  <g transform="translate(80, 250)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="20" y2="0" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="25" y1="0" x2="45" y2="0" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="50" y1="0" x2="70" y2="0" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="75" y1="0" x2="95" y2="0" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="100" y1="0" x2="120" y2="0" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="4" />
    <text x="60" y="25" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#4b5563" text-anchor="middle">Free metal ion</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Spherical Field (Average Energy) -->
  <g transform="translate(220, 200)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="20" y2="0" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="25" y1="0" x2="45" y2="0" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="50" y1="0" x2="70" y2="0" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="75" y1="0" x2="95" y2="0" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="100" y1="0" x2="120" y2="0" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" />
    <text x="60" y="25" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#4b5563" text-anchor="middle">Spherical field</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Connecting lines 1 -->
  <line x1="140" y1="250" x2="220" y2="200" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />

  <!-- Octahedral Splitting -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 0)">
    <!-- eg set (Higher Energy) -->
    <line x1="30" y1="100" x2="50" y2="100" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="60" y1="100" x2="80" y2="100" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" />
    <text x="100" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">eg</text>
    
    <!-- t2g set (Lower Energy) -->
    <line x1="20" y1="300" x2="40" y2="300" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="50" y1="300" x2="70" y2="300" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="80" y1="300" x2="100" y2="300" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" />
    <text x="120" y="305" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#10b981">t2g</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Connecting lines 2 -->
  <line x1="340" y1="200" x2="400" y2="100" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
  <line x1="340" y1="200" x2="400" y2="300" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />

  <!-- Barycenter line -->
  <line x1="340" y1="200" x2="500" y2="200" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="8,4" />
  <text x="420" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#4b5563">Barycenter</text>

  <!-- Splitting Energy (Delta_o) -->
  <line x1="380" y1="100" x2="380" y2="300" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="380,100 375,110 385,110" fill="#374151" />
  <polygon points="380,300 375,290 385,290" fill="#374151" />
  <text x="360" y="205" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151">Δo</text>

  <!-- Energy values -->
  <text x="470" y="150" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#ef4444">+0.6 Δo (or +3/5 Δo)</text>
  <text x="470" y="250" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#10b981">-0.4 Δo (or -2/5 Δo)</text>
</svg>
